questions.stem:

questions.solution:

O | 30.1 | 16 | $\frac{30.1}{16} = 1.88$ | $\frac{1.88}{1.25} = 1.5$ | 3

questions.stem: If shortest wavelength of hydrogen atom in Lyman series is x, then longest wavelength in Balmer series of $\mathrm{He^{+}}$ is:
questions.solution:
$\frac{1}{\lambda} = R_H z^{2}\left(\frac{1}{n_1^{2}} - \frac{1}{n_2^{2}}\right)$
$\frac{1}{x} = R_H (1)^{2}\left[\frac{1}{1^{2}} - \frac{1}{\infty^{2}}\right] \Rightarrow R_H = \frac{1}{x}$
$\frac{1}{\lambda} = \frac{1}{x}(2)^{2}\left[\frac{1}{2^{2}} - \frac{1}{3^{2}}\right]$
$\Rightarrow \lambda = \frac{9x}{5}$

questions.stem: When 0.25 moles of a non-volatile, non-ionizable solute was dissolved in 1 mole of a solvent the vapor pressure of solution was x% of vapor pressure of pure solvent. What is x%?

One mole each of He and A(g) are taken in a 10 L closed flask and heated to 400 K to establish the following equilibrium.
$\mathrm{A(g) \rightleftharpoons B(g)}$
$K_c$ for this reaction at 400 K is 4.0. The partial pressures (in atm) of He and B(g) are respectively (at equilibrium)
(Assume He, A(g) and B(g) behave as ideal gases)
(Given : $R = 0.082\ \mathrm{L\,atm\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$)
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{A(g) \rightleftharpoons B(g)}$
$t = 0$: 1 | –
$t = t_{eq}$: $1 - x = 0.2$ | $x = 0.8$
$\sum n_{eq} = 1 + n_{He} = 2$
$K_C = \frac{\frac{x}{10}}{1 - \frac{x}{10}} = 4$
$\Rightarrow x = \frac{4}{5} = 0.8$
$P_{He} = \frac{nRT}{V} = \frac{1 \times 0.082 \times 400}{10} = 3.28\ \mathrm{atm}$
$P_B = \frac{nRT}{V} = \frac{0.8 \times 0.082 \times 400}{10} = 2.624\ \mathrm{atm}$

questions.stem:
Which of the following are true about the energy of the given d-orbitals of a tetrahedral complex?
A. $d_{xy} = d_{xz} > d_{x^{2}-y^{2}}$
B. $d_{xy} = d_{yz} > d_{z^{2}}$
C. $d_{x^{2}-y^{2}} > d_{z^{2}} > d_{xz}$
D. $d_{x^{2}-y^{2}} = d_{z^{2}} < d_{xz}$
Choose the correct answer from the given below:
questions.solution:
In tetrahedral complex, ligands approach metal ions in between the axis. i.e. orbitals faces more repulsion whose lobes are in between the axis.
(Splitting diagram: $d_{xy}, d_{yz}, d_{zx}$ form the higher-energy $t_2$ set; $d_{x^{2}-y^{2}}, d_{z^{2}}$ form the lower-energy $e$ set.)

2-methylpropene is treated with dilute $\mathrm{H_2SO_4}$ to give major organic product (X).
$R_f$ value for (X) in the same solvent system under identical condition will be:
questions.solution:
Since $R_f$ value $= 0.42$
$\mathrm{CH_3-C(CH_3)=CH_2 \xrightarrow{dil.\ H_2SO_4} CH_3-C(OH)(CH_3)-CH_3}$ (X)

questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.stem:
First and second ionization enthalpies of lithium are $520\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ and $7297\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ respectively. Energy required to convert 3.5 mg lithium (g) into $\mathrm{Li^{2+}(g)}$ $[\mathrm{Li(g)} \rightarrow \mathrm{Li^{2+}(g)}]$ is ________ $\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$. (nearest integer)
[Molar mass of Li $= 7\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$]
questions.solution:
$n_{Li} = \frac{3.5 \times 10^{-3}}{7} = 5 \times 10^{-4}\ \mathrm{mol}$
$\mathrm{Li \longrightarrow Li^{+2} + 2e^{-}}$
$IE = IE_1 + IE_2 = 7817\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
So, energy $= 7817 \times 5 \times 10^{-4} = 3.908\ \mathrm{kJ}$

(Given molar mass in g mol$^{-1}$: H: 1, C: 12, O: 16)

questions.stem:
Sucrose hydrolyses in acidic medium into glucose and fructose by first order rate law with $t_{1/2} = 3$ hour. The percentage of sucrose remaining after 6 hours is _________. (Nearest integer)
(Given : log 2=0.3010 and log 3=0.4771)
questions.solution:
No. of Half lives $= \frac{6}{3} = 2$
Amount of substance remain after 2 half lives $= \frac{[A]_0}{2^{n}} = \frac{[A]_0}{2^{2}} = \frac{[A]_0}{4}$
i.e. % remaining $= \frac{\frac{[A]_0}{4}}{[A]_0} \times 100 = 25\%$

questions.stem:
Consider the reaction $\mathrm{X \rightleftharpoons Y}$ at 300 K . If $\Delta H^{\ominus}$ and K are $28.40\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$ and $1.8 \times 10^{-7}$ at the same temperature, then the magnitude of $\Delta S^{\ominus}$ for the reaction in $\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$ is ______. (Nearest integer)
(Given : $R = 8.3\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$, $\ln 10 = 2.3$, $\log 3 = 0.48$, $\log 2 = 0.30$)
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{X \rightleftharpoons Y}$
$\Delta G^{\circ} = -RT \ln k$
$= -8.3 \times 300 \ln(1.8 \times 10^{-7})$
$= -8.3 \times 300 (-15.5)$
$= 38595\ \mathrm{J}$
$\Delta G^{\circ} = \Delta H^{\circ} - T\Delta S^{\circ}$
$\Delta S^{\circ} = \frac{\Delta H^{\circ} - \Delta G^{\circ}}{T}$
$= \frac{28400 - 38595}{300}$
$= \frac{-10195}{300} = -34\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$
